name: unknowns
description: Know your unknowns — an operating loop for the gap between the map (your plan) and the territory (the actual code and domain). Eleven skills: blind-spot investigation, domain primers, interviews, divergent prototypes, brainstorming, reference analysis, tweak-likelihood-ordered planning, deviation notes, buy-in docs and comprehension quizzes — plus two agents and two hooks. From Thariq Shihipar's (Anthropic) 'Field Guide to Fable' talk and its 'Know your unknowns' examples.
